user.title: Intelleta
user.description: Paste the key from the Intelleta app (Settings › Home Assistant › Make a key). It is shown once. If you did not copy it, make another.

reauth_confirm.title: Intelleta
reauth_confirm.description: Your key is no longer accepted. Make a new one in the Intelleta app (Settings › Home Assistant › Make a new key) and paste it here.

error.invalid_auth: The key was not accepted. Paste the whole key again, or make a new one in the Intelleta app (Settings › Home Assistant › Make a new key).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Intelleta. Check your internet connection and try again in a moment. Your key is probably fine.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. The Home Assistant log has the detail.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: Your new key is in place. Readings resume on their own.

init.title: Share with Intelleta
init.description: Choose the lights, switches, scenes and other things to share with Intelleta. In the Intelleta app you then pick up to six on each device for Andy to control. Their names, kinds and rooms are sent to your Intelleta account, and to Google, which runs Andy's voice, so Andy can recognise them.
